Strategy: Scale the sweet-band bonus with the item size so larger items get a bigger reward for leaving middle residuals, keeping the mid penalty fixed. This steers large items more strongly than small ones, but the scaling is a guess and may misfire.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(15 * item / 50 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (r - item) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
